title: [Import AI] Edge case — no pubdate, harvester fell back to fetch time
raw_text: Edge case — no pubdate, harvester fell back to fetch time — Item delivered no <pubDate>, no <dc:date>, no <updated>. Normalize() returned date_basis 'feed-fallback'. The item still ships, but downstream consumers must treat its ts as best-effort.

meta.label: Import AI
meta.summary: Item delivered no pubDate, no dc:date, no updated. Normalize fell back to fetch time and tagged date_basis as feed-fallback.
